violated_contract: A destructive sweep must admit only the exact document paths its operation declares. Membership in a same-named collection group does not establish that the document belongs to the declared parent or depth; deleting every query result can destroy unrelated state.
canonical_prevention: Check the complete relative document path before counting a destructive match or queuing a delete. Keep behavioral coverage that mixes valid target paths with root-level, foreign-parent, deeper nested and malformed same-name paths, asserting only the valid targets are matched and written in both dry-run and apply modes.
